title: A thick regular blanket is warmer
text: A thick regular blanket is warmer. I'm not impressed with this blanket for a couple of reasons.  It is very soft between the wires. Because it's so thin, you can feel every wire. The sparkly decoration is already peeling off after just 5 days. As for the heat... It gets warm, but not cold weather warm. This is mild heat and it's not any better than just wrapping up in a thicker blanket. The thing works,  but I just prefer a regular,  real blanket for warmth.
